opportunities.title: Revolut Got Phished by a Fake Government Email — And Handed Over Your BTC History
opportunities.why_now: A neobank with millions of crypto-linked users just admitted KYC and Bitcoin transaction data leaked because someone emailed them pretending to be a regulator.
opportunities.angle: Security post-mortem: walk through the social-engineering vector, note it's not a 'hack' but a process failure, and ask why crypto-adjacent fintechs still trust inbound email for data requests.

opportunities.title: Bridge Gets Hacked, Offers Attacker a 20% Finder's Fee — The Ransom Playbook Nobody Admits Is a Playbook
opportunities.why_now: Symbiosis just recovered 15 BTC and dangled a standard 'keep 20%, return the rest' bounty, the same script as every bridge hack before it.
opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition piece: list every bridge exploit that ended in a negotiated bounty, argue this is now just the industry's insurance model in disguise.

opportunities.title: Bitcoin's Golden Cross Just Flickered Off — And $81,700 Is the Only Number That Matters Now
opportunities.why_now: CryptoQuant's resistance call and the fading golden cross give a concrete, falsifiable level right as bitcoin sits out the AI selloff at $78K.
opportunities.angle: Levels-and-skepticism market note: state the thesis plainly, note what invalidates it, avoid hopium — classic 'already priced' framing.

opportunities.title: A Hidden Crypto Mine in Mexico Was Stealing Power and Laundering Cash — This Is What 'Decentralized' Actually Looks Like on the Ground
opportunities.why_now: Authorities just raided a covert mining operation tied to power theft and money laundering, a reminder that mining security failures aren't just cyber.
opportunities.angle: Physical-security explainer: use the raid as a case study in how mining ops become laundering fronts, tying back to why institutional miners now over-invest in compliance theater.

opportunities.title: Bernstein Says the Clarity Act Surprise 'Isn't Priced In' — We've Heard That Before
opportunities.why_now: A major desk is telling clients the market is underestimating regulatory progress, exactly the kind of consensus-defying call this channel exists to stress-test.
opportunities.angle: Contrarian-of-the-contrarian take: trace the last three times a bank said a crypto regulatory catalyst 'wasn't priced in' and check what actually happened to price.
